rules.trained_on: split == 'train' only (calibration and validation rows are NOT used for the final fit)
rules.calibration: none: raw probabilities. Reason (validation, 2026-10-09): Platt slope 1.00 and no Brier gain for the unweighted models; a calibrator must earn its place on validation.

confidence_intervals.method: bootstrap over loans, paired across models

rules.after_the_exam: no model, feature, setting or rule may be changed to improve these results; any later change is a new, labelled experiment and these numbers stay in the record
